title: Sunday Lineup
description: An AI GM agent's Sunday lineup-run output (PLAN.md §4 'Sunday AM — Lineup run'): the starting lineup plus a 1-paragraph in-character justification. Validated for legal slots by scripts/lib/rosters.validate_lineup before it is written to the team's roster.json.

starters.description: slot -> player_id, one entry per starter slot in teams/*/roster.json (e.g. QB, RB1, RB2, WR1, WR2, TE, FLEX, K, DEF). Every slot must be filled with a position-eligible player id (no nulls) for a lineup to be legal.

justification.description: 1-paragraph in-character explanation of the lineup choices, including any acknowledgment of starting a BYE/Out player.

forum_post.description: Optional trash-talk post for the week's forum (state/forum/2026-wNN.jsonl). Appended optionally after Sunday run; at most one post per team per week.
